//==
// # Geospatial terrain and rasters
//
// Gridded planet data and the addressing that ties raster pixels to ground:
// elevation grids, the pixel-to-projected-coordinate mapping of a north-up
// image, and slippy-map tile addresses. Distances are Length.

// A regular grid of terrain elevations over a geographic region. Elevations
// are in meters above the datum's reference surface; the column index runs
// west to east and the row index runs south to north across Bounds.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Digital_elevation_model)
type ElevationGrid
{
    Bounds: GeoBounds;
    Elevations: Array2D<Number>;
}
